**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation in either direction:

- **Searches came back empty** for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "best", "price", "discount", and "wholesale" — there is no MFN construct in the document.
- **Fees; Payment (§§ 3.1–3.4)** sets a fixed economic term — 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000/month threshold, with monthly payment, quarterly reconciliation, and an HDI audit right. Nothing requires the Company to extend HDI terms given to third parties or to match a third-party offer.
- **§ 6.1 Exclusivity** was the closest "best terms" candidate, but it is a category restriction (Company won't participate in similar Internet projects for Deerskin Products; HDI gets exclusive online use of the "Deerskin" brand), not an MFN pricing obligation. That commercial term belongs to the exclusivity rule and is not double-flagged here.

This sits at the **preferred position** — no MFN burdens the Customer — so the rule is satisfied without amendment.
